Thanatophoric dysplasia: The patient's presentation of microcephaly, low-set ears, cleft lip and palate, micrognathia, and limb abnormalities, combined with radiographic findings, could also suggest this diagnosis, although it is considered less likely than Femoral hypoplasia-unusual facies syndrome.
